definitions.gloss: creator; author; originator of a creative work
definitions.explanation: The person who creates an original work — a novel, illustration, song, game, video, or other artistic or creative product. Increasingly common in online and publishing contexts to refer to individual creators (authors, artists, designers, content makers) and to distinguish them from mere reproducers or users.

examples.japanese: {創作者|そうさくしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the name of the creator.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}の{創作者|そうさくしゃ}には{著作権|ちょさくけん}が{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: The creator of this work is granted copyright.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}によって、{誰|だれ}でも{自由|じゆう}に{作品|さくひん}を{発表|はっぴょう}できる{創作者|そうさくしゃ}になれる{時代|じだい}になった。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, we've entered an era in which anyone can become a creator who freely publishes their work.

notes:
Composed of {創作|そうさく} (creation, original work) and the suffix {〜者|しゃ} (person). A somewhat formal, written-register word. Often appears in copyright and intellectual-property contexts (the person whose rights attach to a work), and in online discussions of original content — for example, contrasting {創作者|そうさくしゃ} with {模倣者|もほうしゃ} (imitator) or {消費者|しょうひしゃ} (consumer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}の{権利|けんり}: the creator's rights
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}{本人|ほんにん}: the creator themselves
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}の{意図|いと}: the creator's intent
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}として{活動|かつどう}する: to work/be active as a creator
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}を{尊重|そんちょう}する: to respect the creator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作者|さくしゃ}: author — the everyday word for the author of a specific work (of literature, art, etc.)
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: author (of a book) — specifically the writer of a published book
- クリエイター: creator — the borrowed word; especially common for online/social-media content creators
- {作家|さっか}: writer, artist — a professional whose job is creative work
- {創作家|そうさくか}: creative artist — very close in meaning; less common than {創作者|そうさくしゃ}
